permission_autostart_body: On Xiaomi, Huawei, Oppo and similar devices, enable auto-start so prayer-time notifications keep working after the phone restarts.
permission_battery_body: Allow this app to ignore battery optimization so prayer-time reminders fire on time even after your screen is off.
permission_location_body: Location lets us show accurate prayer times for your area, the qibla direction and the nearest mosques. You can change this later in settings.
permission_notification_body: We'll send adhan, iftar and other important reminders right on time. You can change this later in settings.
pray_step_niyyah_body: Set the intention in your heart for which prayer you are about to perform. It is not spoken aloud.
pray_step_qiyam_body: Standing with hands folded, recite Surah Al-Fatiha followed by another short surah.
pray_step_ruku_body: Bow with your back parallel to the ground and say "Subhana Rabbiyal Adheem" three times.
pray_step_salam_body: Turn your head right and left saying "Assalamu Alaikum wa Rahmatullah" to complete the prayer.
pray_step_sujud_body: Prostrate with forehead, nose, palms, knees and toes touching the ground. Say "Subhana Rabbiyal A'la" three times.
pray_step_takbir_body: Raise your hands to your ears and say "Allahu Akbar" to begin the prayer.
pray_step_tashahhud_body: Sit between the prostrations and after the second rakah recite the Tashahhud.
